## Checklist

- [ ] `make lint` and `make test` pass locally
- [ ] `make up && make smoke` passes, if the change touches more than one component
- [ ] Contract changes (`contracts/openapi.yaml`, `docs/CONTRACTS.md`) are intentional, and `npm run gen:api` was re-run
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or credentials in code, logs or fixtures
- [ ] Docs and comments describe the new behaviour
